# FrontendTools

> > A comprehensive collection of 30+ free, browser-based developer tools and educational resources for frontend development, covering CSS, JavaScript, React, image optimization, and accessibility.

FrontendTools.tech provides client-side processing tools built with Next.js 15 and React 18, ensuring privacy and performance. The platform combines practical utilities (PDF merger, regex tester, accessibility scanner) with in-depth guides on modern web technologies including WebAssembly, Core Web Vitals, and WCAG compliance.

## Key Topics

- Frontend Development
- CSS (Variables, Units, Animations)
- JavaScript & React
- Image Optimization (WebP, AVIF, PNG, SVG)
- Accessibility & WCAG 2.2
- Core Web Vitals
- Client-Side Processing
- Responsive Design
- VS Code Extensions
- Next.js & Tailwind CSS
- JSON & Base64 Handling
- WebAssembly
- Frontend Security (XSS, CSRF)
- Web Performance
- Developer Tools

## Free Developer Tools

- [Free Frontend Tools 2026 - 30+ Developer Utilities](https://frontendtools.tech): Homepage: 30+ free frontend tools for CSS, images, JSON, SVG & more
- [PDF Merger – Merge PDFs in Browser, No Upload](https://frontendtools.tech/tools/pdf-merger): Browser-based PDF merger tool - combine PDFs client-side, no upload
- [Testing & Accessibility - 1 Free Tools](https://frontendtools.tech/tools/cluster/testing-accessibility): WCAG 2.2 & ADA accessibility scanner for contrast, ARIA & navigation
- [Utilities - 3 Free Tools](https://frontendtools.tech/tools/cluster/utilities): URL shortener, regex tester & character converter utilities cluster

## Image Optimization & Formats

- [Image Optimization 2025: WebP, AVIF & Best Practices Guide](https://frontendtools.tech/blog/modern-image-optimization-techniques-2025): Image optimization: WebP, AVIF, compression & Core Web Vitals guide
- [Image Optimization Guide: WebP, AVIF, Compression & Base64 Encoding](https://frontendtools.tech/blog/optimize-images-web-base64-compression-guide): Optimize images: WebP, AVIF, Base64 encoding & Core Web Vitals tips
- [SVG vs PNG vs WebP: Which Image Format to Use & When Guide](https://frontendtools.tech/blog/svg-vs-png-vs-webp-image-formats): SVG vs PNG vs WebP comparison: when to use each format for performance
- [10 Common SVG Path Mistakes and How to Fix Them](https://frontendtools.tech/blog/10-common-svg-path-mistakes-how-to-fix-them): Fix 10 common SVG path errors with before/after examples from Figma

## CSS & Responsive Design

- [CSS Units Guide: px vs rem vs em vs vh Compared](https://frontendtools.tech/blog/css-units-responsive-design-2025): CSS units compared: px vs rem vs em vs vh with charts & examples
- [CSS Variables Guide: Design Tokens & Theming](https://frontendtools.tech/blog/css-variables-guide-design-tokens-theming-2025): CSS Variables for design tokens, theming & dark mode implementation
- [Advanced Responsive Design: Beyond Media Queries with Fluid CSS](https://frontendtools.tech/blog/advanced-responsive-design-beyond-media-queries): Fluid CSS design beyond media queries: clamp(), Flexbox & Grid techniques
- [Interactive CSS Animations: Complete Tutorial for Web Apps](https://frontendtools.tech/blog/interactive-css-animations-web-apps): CSS animations tutorial: keyframes, transitions & interactive effects
- [Color Theory in UI Design: Complete Guide with WCAG Accessibility](https://frontendtools.tech/blog/color-theory-ui-design): UI color theory: palettes, harmony & WCAG accessibility standards
